name: citt
description: Scan Android apps with CanITrustThat and see what is inside: ad SDKs, analytics, data brokers, residential proxy SDKs, keys and secrets, known-vulnerable libraries, consent and children's signals.

interface.shortDescription: Scan Android apps and read what is inside
interface.longDescription: Scan an Android app by package id or Google Play link and read its findings: ad SDKs, analytics, attribution, data brokers, residential proxy SDKs, keys and secrets, known-vulnerable libraries, consent and children's signals, store declarations. Ask a question about an app's decompiled code. Researcher plans add projects, CSV submits, scrutiny and exports.
defaultPrompt: Scan com.example.app with citt and list its ad SDKs
Show the keys and secrets citt found in com.example.app
Ask citt which analytics SDKs com.example.app includes
